text.p: Typhoon Dale will mainly impact shipping during this period. It currently has winds of 120 mph and is located about 570 miles south-southwest of Tokyo. It is tracking towards the northeast at 25 mph. It is expected to become extratropical as it moves out to sea well to the southeast and east of Honshu Japan during the next 12-24 hours.

Tropical Storm Ernie is causing some local flooding in north Luzon as it is mostly over land at this time. Winds of up to 40 mph are being reported. Ernie may become more important for shipping as it moves back off the west coast in about 24 hours.

One storm is heading towards Scandinavia as a second storm lingers in southern Portugal. Strong winds have been a problem in west Europe during the past day or two. These winds are quite warm in the east and fairly cool in the west. Strong winds will continue to be a problem for the next day or two. This will be especially important for shipping interests in the Bay of Biscay, through the strait of Gibraltar and into the western Mediterranean sea. Wind and rain also impacts Morocco during this period. Locally flooding rain is possible.
